verdict: The resource-safety remediation is executable and the Phase 1/2/3 boundary is now truthful, but the TypeScript 6 compatibility compiler is not actually pinned to 6.0.2 and blocks acceptance.

evidence: An isolated pnpm install of typescript7@npm:typescript@7.0.2 executes node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc as Version 7.0.2.
The same install of typescript@npm:@typescript/typescript6@6.0.2 executes node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 as Version 6.0.3, not 6.0.2.
Live registry metadata shows @typescript/typescript6@6.0.2 depends on @typescript/old as npm:typescript@^6; pnpm resolves that floating dependency to typescript@6.0.3.

phase_boundaries.evidence: Phase 1 defines artifacts only, Phase 2 is limited to deterministic real subprocess fixtures, and Phase 3 explicitly installs and runs the real compiler packages. The 36-test contract suite enforces this distinction.

resource_stop_loss.evidence: The contract now requires positive integer stop-loss thresholds, exact 80 percent RSS and 50 percent swap formulas below their maxima, ordered process-group SIGTERM, a 5-second grace period, SIGKILL escalation, child waits, and full reap verification. Counterexamples are present and the suite passes.

compiler_baseline_truthfulness.evidence: The current repository compiler reports Version 5.9.3, the independently derived denominator and captured baseline both contain 33 workspaces, every raw evidence SHA and line count plus the null-path zero-output convention passes its integrity test, and the baseline explicitly discloses that the last two rows form an amended 2026-07-15 cohort rather than one clean capture. The top-level captured_at remains the original 2026-07-14 timestamp, so consumers must rely on per-row timestamps and the contamination note for provenance.

blocking_findings.title: Exact TypeScript 6 wrapper pin resolves a floating 6.0.3 compiler
blocking_findings.evidence: @typescript/typescript6@6.0.2 is exactly pinned only at the wrapper layer. Its published dependency @typescript/old=npm:typescript@^6 resolved to typescript@6.0.3 in a clean isolated pnpm install, and the promised compatibility command printed Version 6.0.3.
blocking_findings.impact: The compiler used for parity and rollback can drift without a contract change, invalidating diagnostic baselines, cache identity, reproducibility, and the claim that TypeScript 6.0.2 is the compatibility compiler.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Pin the transitive @typescript/old compiler to npm:typescript@6.0.2 with a reviewed pnpm override or revise the contract to an exact currently supported compiler version. Add an installed-layout contract asserting both package metadata and each executable's --version output, then regenerate and frozen-install the lockfile in the owning phase.

resolved_findings.evidence: Stop-loss threshold formulas and bounded SIGTERM-to-SIGKILL process-group reaping are now required and tested.

retry_recommendation: Remediate TS7-P1-RB-R1 and repeat the isolated installed-layout executable-version proof before Phase 2 authorization.
